paras: Riolama uzzelli is a species of lizard in the family Gymnophthalmidae. The species is endemic to Venezuela.
The specific name, uzzelli, is in honor of American Herpetologist Thomas Marshall Uzzell, Jr. (born 1932).
R. uzzelli is found in the Venezuelan state of Amazonas.
The natural habitat of R. uzzelli is the summit of a tepui, at altitudes of 1,850–2,600 m (6,070–8,530 ft).
